column1: # rubric.tsv — the sections of the memres warrant set, one per test module, in document order.

column2: The Manifest: Observed Peaks Bucketed to Powers of Two, Delta-Encoded Against the Resolution Default
The Store: A Real Sqlite File That Raises a Peak but Never Lowers It, Queried Back as a Manifest
The Projection: The Store Rendered to mem.json, With Drift Named and Absence Left Alone
The Harvest: Peaks Found Under an Output Tree Folded Into the Store, Worst Cell Kept
The Convergence Check: Which Grid Projects Still Run on the Floor, Read From a Planted Tree
The Sweep Budget: The Operator Override, Else Forty Percent of a Planted MemTotal
The CPU Weight: A Planted cgroup Host Weighted, Joined and Verified, With the Server Moved In
The Zswap Probe: One Planted cgroup Sampled in a Pass, Every Field Labelled, the Selftest Honest
The Memory Rail: Level, Slope and Acceleration of Headroom, an Allowance That Shrinks At Once and Recovers a Cell at a Time, and Never More Optimistic Than the Level Measured
The Rail Sampler's Pure Half: Meminfo Read Into a Level, Every Evaluation Counted as Exactly One of a Shrink, a Recovery or a Hold, and the Rail Published as Metrics
The Rail Sampler's Loop: The Fence Resized Only When the Allowance Changes, a Refused Resize Keeping the Old Allowance and Counted, and a Round Limit That Sleeps Between Rounds
